from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one document/report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this document reports on")
    credit_impairment_loss: float | None = Field(description="The credit impairment loss reported, or None if not mentioned in this document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_financial_data: list[DocumentFinancialData]
